description.text: Teaching Objectives This master program is targeted to train the master candidates in a variety of economic studies in economic development, industrial organization, international trade, investment, financial innovation, resources and environmental economics, and financial management. The teaching staff are composed of professors possessing an oversea backgrounds in Euramerican top universities such as Yale or Oxford and an rich experience in teaching and supervising international students. The Nobel Prize Winners, Professor Robert A. Mundell and Professor Clivew.J.Granger, were invited to give lectures at school. Durations Fall Semester: the end of August to the middle of December Spring Semester: the end of January to the end of May Summer Term: the beginning of June to the end of July Main Courses Internship The university has special apartment to help international student find internship chances in good companies and organizations. Diploma Awarded Bachelor of Economics Future Career The university will help get employ chances in good companies and organizations. Research Orientation Industrial organization and competition, Regional economic development strategy and programming, International investment and Multinational business management, Financial innovation and financial engineering, Resources and environmental economic analysis. Note: Masters' Degree Programs for Class Formed Only by International Students are required to have as least 12 students in one program.

duration.text: The Economics at Wuhan University of Technology is a 2.5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3194 USD/per year ￥ 23000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) 2. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 5. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 6. Undergraduate school transcript

requirements.text: 1. Aged 18 or above 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health. 3. Hold a Bachelor's degree.
